matches.rationale: GT1 concerns Proposition 1's closed-form velocity formula being stated incorrectly (missing normalization vs. normalized weighted average). Pred_1 flags an error in Equation (5)'s underbrace about the conditional velocity u^{cond}, and Pred_2 addresses Proposition 2's proof. Neither finding implicates Proposition 1 or its closed-form formula, so R1 (locus) is not satisfied.

GT2 concerns an inconsistency in Proposition 2's claim about unbiasedness of the Monte Carlo estimator. Pred_2 identifies an algebraic error (missing factor n) in the proof of Proposition 2(iii) about variance, not about the bias/unbiasedness claim. The locus overlaps (both in Proposition 2) but the specific defect differs: GT2 is about bias claims contradicting sampling theory, Pred_2 is about a variance calculation error. R1 and R4 are not satisfied.
